integrity: A complete proof is supplied. Prior knowledge includes the published incidence-growth identity and unrestricted arbitrary incidence-peak representability; only the constrained sharp prominence/unbounded tiny-peak dichotomy is asserted as new. Independent scientific validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The model is normalized deterministic SIR, with positive C1 nonincreasing time-dependent transmission. The logarithmic peak-to-trough budget assumes H=beta(S-I)-gamma>=0 and chronologically ordered disjoint drop intervals. The analytic all-count family is on a fixed short time interval, and the extra peaks have no uniform positive prominence, persistence interpretation or robustness to smoothing.
title: Sharp incidence-prominence budget with unbounded micro-peak count under monotone transmission
